data.text: I’d like to propose this month’s catches: John 12 tons, Kate 12, Jack 12, Emma 12, and me 2. I’m voluntarily offering a smaller share so each of you can earn $12,000 rather than $10,000 this month. That totals 50 tons, leaving 50 to double back to 100. My own catch this month will be 2 tons. Your shares are proposals, not assumptions—would each of you agree to 12? We can discuss future months separately. John, what do you think?
